test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘CAGE’ is written as ‘92’ and ‘BURN’ is written as ‘53’. How will ‘TORCH’ be written in that language?
solution:
Here, we use the tables given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7c328952c63375464d6c677411c1f4e7339f7dfa7cc68e17df8479d7bcba7a2.png] 

The logic followed in the given codes:

**Logic: **"Sum of the positional values of the opposite alphabet".

‘CAGE’ is written as ‘92’ →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e82d35519f16e2b7462f9b157b63023ff0e1a1327e0f35a5a87b99657c73932b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f16a5c5b72e880834ec4150ebf8f30928a7926baffc26a1320ae19d33c1d7bd6.png] 

‘BURN’ is written as ‘53’ →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79699e64291d05de6de413ea713fb253c8be1723c08dcafabd566c1197b4bc7e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea8f2f542583653de7f12eb3a69b0399c93b8bd818df6bf8247185f7bf02bb5e.png] 

Similarly, 'TORCH' will be coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe3660cbb8991c7bb107dd9a35a7c766e854a4b47a70246f440f5e2652dceae6.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cd286b67cb39edaabb13ae08d38c19211eb12e6a5d2195428346a87d849c23d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "71".
